author: neal_illustrator
title: Hiring artists for comic and animation teams
content: Heyo! I’m doing an all call looking for artists to help build out my comic and animation teams! I think it’s time to try and ease up some of the stress and expand my team! I’m excited to see y’all’s portfolios! I’m so excited to have the team grow! I’m like a little studio now! ⭐️Stay stellar!! Application Links are in my linktree (in bio)

author: harrier_studio
title: Harrier Studio hiring illustrators and comic artists
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! OPEN POSITIONS: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Send CV & Portfolio to: harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subject: Nama – Posisi – CV & Portofolio). Open until all positions filled.

author: johnnymurrayproduction
title: Looking for visual co-author / illustrator
content: WE HAVE THE STORIES. YOU BRING THE IMAGES. Johnny Murray Production is now looking for a VISUAL CO-AUTHOR. We are looking for an artist who can help transform sound into images — Animation Directors, Visual Storytellers, Animators, Illustrators, Motion Designers, VFX Artists. First visual pilot: Mundus Imaginalis. Interested? Send your portfolio / showreel or simply tell us what you see when you hear Mundus Imaginalis.
